maddeler.e:
يتناوم (form VI)
# يَتَنَاوَمُ (yatanāwamu) /ja.ta.naː.wa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
# يَتَنَاوَمَ (yatanāwama) /ja.ta.naː.wa.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
# يَتَنَاوَمْ (yatanāwam) /ja.ta.naː.wam/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاوَمَ (tanāwama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
